load_synonyms: load a synonym dictionary from a JSON file and return it as a defaultdict
load_dataset: load the SST2 dataset from tensorflow datasets for a given mode and character level
expand_by_one_perturbation: expand a tokenized sentence by replacing each token with all its synonyms
find_up_to_depth_k_perturbations: find all sentences reachable by up to k synonym perturbations recursively
verify_exhaustively: verify if a sample sentence is robust against all synonym perturbations up to delta
